messages:
ingrid: FYI ran hf->rw conversion + quant pipeline on the new MPT fork. unit tests passed but downstream evals show token misalignment and hallucination spike. suspected shard/key mapping issue.

convert-bot: convert-cli v0.9.1 started: hf_repo=mpt-x/custom, rev=main, out=/tmp/rw-mptx, quant=4bit

devon: any logs? even a tiny KeyError trace helps.

ingrid: paste below — shortened: ```Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"/opt/convert/convert.py\", line 422, in load_shards
    weights = shard_index[weight_key]
KeyError: 'model.layers.5.self_attn.q_proj'
```

matt: that key looks like old hf naming vs our canonical rw keys. did the weight-rename map get applied? sometimes hub partial-download + retry can produce a shard index that never got updated with the remap.

convert-bot: hub download: 200 OK for shard-0.safetensors, shard-1.safetensors
hub download: 403 Forbidden for shard-2.safetensors (retrying)
hub download: 200 OK for shard-2.safetensors (after auth refresh)

sara: 403 then 200 could mean shard-2 was uploaded from a different revision or arrived incomplete earlier — convert tool merges index blobs by order downloaded which can reorder mapping if shard metadata differs.

devon: aha — so partial/auth-retry produced a different ordering and our loader uses file-level key-map precedence. If shard 2 contains the q_proj names but the final index was assembled with older shards first, remapping might not patch them.

ingrid: quick repro: I re-run with --verify-shard-keys and got mismatch report: ```shard-0 keys: model.layers.*.attn.q
shard-2 keys: model.layers.*.self_attn.q_proj```

matt: fix options: 1) make convert-cli normalize weight names on read (apply renames per-layer regardless of shard order) 2) reject on key namespace divergence (fail-fast) 3) post-merge remap pass. I prefer 1 for safety.

sara: also need to handle chat templates: chat_template.json still refers to special token <|bos|> but tokenizer in this repo uses <s>. That plus mis-merged tokenizers can shift tokenization boundaries after quant.

devon: proposed immediate patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/convert-cli/pull/982 — apply weight-rename canonicalization low-level and add a --strict-shard-check flag. Testing now on CI.

convert-bot: CI job convert-eval-982 started (commit: 6a1f3b2)

matt: small note — when you canonicalize names, add a mapping warning for any unexpected suffixes (e.g., _proj vs .q) so we can triage model-specific renames upstream.

ingrid: ran the patched converter locally, then ran quick quant eval (ppl + 100-shot instruction subset). result: hallucination rate down to baseline, token alignment fixed. still ~0.6% ppl increase after 4-bit quant but within expected.

sara: awesome. can you paste the command you ran so I can reproduce?

ingrid: `./convert-cli --repo mpt-x/custom --rev main --out /tmp/rw-mptx --quant 4bit --verify-shard-keys --canonicalize-weights`

devon: thanks — I'll bake the patch and add a small test that simulates a 403-retry reorder case. also add a check in the hub downloader to preserve original shard metadata and fail if anomaly detected.

matt: add note to onboarding checklist: always run `--verify-shard-keys` and validate chat_template special tokens vs tokenizer.vocab before quant runs. saves an hour. :thumbsup:

ingrid: filing a follow-up issue with repro artifacts + eval logs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/convert-cli/issues/1234 — attaching the shard-key diffs and sample prompts that triggered the hallucination.

sara: :eyes: will sync with support to see if any customers saw related behavior. thanks everyone!

devon: closing loop when PR merges and CI green. :shipit:
